title: Tech View and Board View are unavailable while Imported is selected
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes (longer if an import is needed)
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • At least one Imported work order at this location (Imported work orders come only from an invoice import: Settings > Invoices (in the IMPORTS group): click Download Template, fill one row in the template (keep its heading row; the columns marked * are required; Shop Location = this location's name, a customer name, an Invoice Number such as ZZIMP-1001, Invoice Date as month/day/year e.g. 10/01/2026, Item Labor, a Line Title, Qty 1, Rate 100, Total 100, Tax Amount 5), save it as a .csv file, click Select CSV File, pick the file and click Import Invoices; the message reads "All invoices have been imported successfully." The imported work order's number is the Invoice Number you typed, and it is listed only when Status > Imported is ticked).
  • At least one ordinary work order (Work Orders > Create Work Order).
  • The Status filter starts with nothing ticked.

Setup

  1. Work Orders > All > List > Status > tick "Imported": if no row shows, import invoices at Settings > Data Import > Invoices so at least one Imported work order exists at this location. Then Status > "Clear selection".
  2. If the location has no ordinary work order, create one: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick a Customer and its Asset > Save.
  3. Check the setup worked: with Status > "Imported" ticked the List shows at least one row; with the selection cleared, other work orders show too. If no Imported work order can be made, the case cannot start: report it as Blocked with that reason.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Click List in the display switcher (tooltip "List").
  3. Click Status and tick "Imported".
  4. Hover the Tech View and Board View buttons in the display switcher and try to click each.
  5. Click Status > "Clear selection".
  6. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  7. Click Status and look at the "Imported" option. Try to tick it.
  8. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  9. Click Status and try to tick "Imported".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: while Imported is selected, Tech View and Board View cannot be chosen. A tooltip explains why (write down its words). The List keeps showing the Imported work orders.
  • Step 7: in Tech View the Imported option in Status is disabled and cannot be ticked.
  • Step 9: in Board View the Imported option is disabled too.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; Work Orders Board View & Tech View Display Options Technical Implementation Plan (revised 24 Sep 2026, uploaded 8 Oct 2026), section 1.4 (follow-up A3) and section 3.26, Phase 9; answered by Sasha Grosman in the PRD footer comment of 24 Sep 2026. The PRD of 7 Oct does not cover it; the tech plan informs and does not overrule the PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Tech plan 1.4 Imported: “Confirmed + extended: board displays unavailable while Imported is selected, and Imported is disabled as a Status-filter option in Tech View and Board View”
  • Tech plan 3.26 Imported: “Imported is excluded from the board displays (follow-up A3). While the Imported status chip is selected, Tech View and Board View are disabled in the switcher with a tooltip; while in Tech View or Board View, the Imported option in the Status filter is disabled.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
